name: twenty-monorepo
//resolutions: Each entry forces a version outside some parent's declared range because no parent release carries the fix, or keeps a single copy of a package for type identity where noted; remove each once its drop condition is met. zapier-platform-core/form-data 4.0.6 -> CVE-2026-12143 / GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx (CRLF injection via unescaped multipart field names and filenames, vulnerable >=4.0.0 <4.0.6); zapier-platform-core exact-pins form-data 4.0.5, still in its latest 19.x. Drop once zapier-platform-core depends on form-data >=4.0.6. @remote-dom/react/@types/react ^19.2.0 -> type identity: @remote-dom/react (via twenty-front-component-renderer) lists @types/react ^18 and nests its own copy; React 18 and 19 declare ReactNode differently, so the two copies are mutually non-assignable and break twenty-front's typecheck. Drop once @remote-dom/react widens @types/react to ^19 (Shopify/remote-dom#153). graphql 16.8.1 -> singleton pin held below msw's ^16.12.0 dependency and @nestjs/graphql's ^16.11.0 peer; drop after a validated repo-wide bump to the latest 16.x. graphql-redis-subscriptions/ioredis 5.10.1 -> type identity: twenty-server passes its ioredis client into RedisPubSub, so this must equal the ioredis version twenty-server and bullmq pin; bump in lockstep with them. @types/qs 6.9.16 -> held below the 6.9.17 ParsedQs typing break (node-saml wants ^6.9.18); drop once twenty-server typechecks against the current @types/qs. @opentelemetry/api 1.9.1 -> singleton guard for the NoopMeterProvider bug (#20231): ai 6.0.33 (via @scalar/agent-chat) pins 1.9.0 exactly while @sentry/node wants ^1.9.1. Drop once @scalar/agent-chat moves off ai 6.0.33. chokidar ^3.6.0 -> NestJS CLI watch mode needs fsevents on macOS, which chokidar 4 and 5 removed (#20316); drop once the NestJS CLI watch works on chokidar 4+. tmp ^0.2.7 -> GHSA-7c78-jf6q-g5cm / CVE-2026-49982 (HIGH, path traversal via a type-confusion bypass of _assertPath, vulnerable >=0.2.6 <0.2.7) and GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65 / CVE-2026-44705 (HIGH, path traversal via unsanitized prefix/postfix, vulnerable <0.2.6). zapier-platform-cli 19 (latest 19.1.0) pins tmp 0.2.5 and inquirer 7/8's external-editor wants ^0.0.33. Drop once both resolve tmp >=0.2.7 on their own. @angular-devkit/core 19.2.24 -> brings picomatch 4.0.4 for GHSA-c2c7-rcm5-vvqj / CVE-2026-33671 (HIGH, ReDoS via extglob quantifiers) and GHSA-3v7f-55p6-f55p / CVE-2026-33672 (MEDIUM, method injection in POSIX character classes), both vulnerable >=4.0.0 <4.0.4, reached through @nestjs/cli. Blocked on an @nestjs/cli release above 11.0.23 that fixes its dist/src output regression (the repo holds @nestjs/cli at 11.0.16). yeoman-environment 6.0.1 -> GHSA-vv9j-gjw2-j8wp / CVE-2026-42089 (HIGH, arbitrary package installation, vulnerable >=2.9.0 <6.0.1); zapier-platform-cli 19 (latest 19.1.0) pins 4.4.3. Drop once zapier-platform-cli depends on yeoman-environment >=6.0.1. express/qs 6.16.0 -> GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g / CVE-2026-82417 (DoS via attacker-controlled isBuffer, >=2.2.5 <6.16.0) and GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx / CVE-2026-82562 (array-limit bypass via bracket-key comma parsing, >=6.14.2 <=6.15.3) for the express 4.22.0 / 4.22.2 copies @mintlify/previewing exact-pins in its latest releases (express 4.22.3 itself moved to qs ~6.16.0). Drop once @mintlify/previewing pins express >=4.22.3 or moves off 4.x. googleapis/googleapis-common 8.0.1 -> type identity: googleapis-common 8.0.2 pins google-auth-library 10.5.0 and gaxios 7.1.3 exactly while googleapis 173 pulls google-auth-library ^10.2.0, so two OAuth2Client copies diverge and break the gmail and calendar services' typecheck. 8.0.1 is the last release with range dependencies, so both collapse to one copy. Drop once googleapis moves to a googleapis-common with range dependencies. @cyntler/react-doc-viewer/ajv 8.20.0 -> GHSA-2g4f-4pwh-qvx6 / CVE-2025-69873 (MEDIUM, ReDoS when using the $data option, vulnerable >=7.0.0-alpha.0 <8.18.0); @cyntler/react-doc-viewer (latest 1.17.1) declares ajv ^7 but never imports it, so forcing 8.x is safe. Drop once it moves to ajv >=8.18.0 or drops ajv. front-matter/js-yaml 4.3.2 -> front-matter 4.0.2 (via mintlify in twenty-docs) is moved from js-yaml 3.x onto the maintained 4.x line, at 4.3.2 past GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh, because it parses docs content and the 3.x line only receives backports. Requires the front-matter@npm:4.0.2 patch below; drop both together, once mintlify moves front-matter off js-yaml 3.x or drops it. @lingui/cli/esbuild 0.28.1 -> GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr (Deno-module binary-integrity RCE, >=0.17.0 <0.28.1) and GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr (Windows dev-server path traversal, >=0.27.3 <0.28.1), both fixed in 0.28.1; @lingui/cli 5.x declares esbuild ^0.25.1 (6.x drops esbuild but is a major migration). Drop once @lingui/cli resolves esbuild >=0.28.1 on its own. @opennextjs/aws/esbuild 0.28.1 -> GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr and GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr (see @lingui/cli/esbuild); @opennextjs/aws exact-pins esbuild 0.25.4, still in its latest 4.1.6. Drop once @opennextjs/aws pins esbuild >=0.28.1. zapier-platform-cli/esbuild 0.28.1 -> GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr and GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr (see @lingui/cli/esbuild); zapier-platform-cli exact-pins esbuild 0.25.8, still in its latest 19.1.0. Drop once zapier-platform-cli pins esbuild >=0.28.1. front-matter@npm:4.0.2 patch -> js-yaml 4.x removed the safeLoad API front-matter's default path calls, so .yarn/patches/front-matter-npm-4.0.2-e1cc0efa69.patch sets loader = parser.load, which is safe by default in 4.x. A matched pair with front-matter/js-yaml: the patch without that pin would select 3.x's unsafe full-schema load, so drop both together. @react-email/ui/next 16.3.8 -> @react-email/ui (via react-email in twenty-emails) exact-pins a vulnerable next: its latest 6.11.0 pins 16.3.3, inside GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j (remote code execution in next/og ImageResponse, >=16.2.0 <16.3.6). Pinned to the version twenty-website resolves within ^16.2.6 so react-email dedupes onto that single next copy instead of pulling a second next subtree; move it in step with twenty-website's next. Drop once @react-email/ui depends on the next version twenty-website resolves. zapier-platform-cli/adm-zip 0.6.1 -> GHSA-8238-w5pm-2374, GHSA-rcw4-f5rp-g42v and GHSA-j5f4-cc29-5x44 (HIGH) plus GHSA-c6fg-446q-cg94 and GHSA-p634-w6r4-rjp2, all vulnerable <=0.6.0 and fixed in 0.6.1; zapier-platform-cli exact-pins adm-zip 0.5.16, still in its latest 19.1.0. Drop once zapier-platform-cli ships adm-zip >=0.6.1. @mintlify/cli/adm-zip 0.6.1 -> the adm-zip <=0.6.0 advisories (see zapier-platform-cli/adm-zip); @mintlify/cli exact-pins adm-zip 0.6.0 in its latest release. Drop once @mintlify/cli ships adm-zip >=0.6.1. @mintlify/previewing/adm-zip 0.6.1 -> the adm-zip <=0.6.0 advisories (see zapier-platform-cli/adm-zip); @mintlify/previewing exact-pins adm-zip 0.6.0 in its latest release. Drop once @mintlify/previewing ships adm-zip >=0.6.1. nx/smol-toml 1.7.1 -> GHSA-7w5x-hrqm-74c2 / CVE-2026-85730 (DoS via malformed TOML documents, vulnerable <=1.7.0); nx exact-pins 1.6.1, still in 23.2.1. Drop once nx pins >=1.7.1. js-yaml@npm:4.3.1 -> 4.3.2 -> GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh / CVE-2026-84375 (maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources, vulnerable >=4.0.0 <4.3.2). The six @mintlify/* packages (cli, common, prebuild, previewing, scraping, validation) exact-pin 4.3.1 in their latest releases; descriptor-keyed so only that exact pin moves. Drop once mintlify pins js-yaml >=4.3.2. @verdaccio/config/js-yaml 5.4.2 -> GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm (the 5.x line's maxTotalMergeKeys advisory, vulnerable >=5.0.0 <=5.4.0, fixed 5.4.1); @verdaccio/config exact-pins 5.2.2, still in its latest 8.3.0 (verdaccio is the local registry the create-app e2e CI publishes to). Held at the latest 5.x patch. Drop once @verdaccio/config pins js-yaml >=5.4.1. sharp@npm:0.33.5 -> 0.35.5 -> GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (libvips CVEs, vulnerable <0.35.0), GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c (bundled libheif, vulnerable <0.35.4) and GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w (bundled librsvg, vulnerable <0.35.5); @mintlify/prebuild exact-pins sharp 0.33.5 in its latest release. Descriptor-keyed so only that exact pin moves; docs and website build tooling only, never in the runtime images. Drop once @mintlify/prebuild pins sharp >=0.35.5. sharp@npm:^0.33.1 -> 0.35.5 -> the same sharp advisories (see sharp@npm:0.33.5) for favicons 7.2.0's ^0.33.1 range; @mintlify/prebuild exact-pins favicons 7.2.0 in its latest release. Safe because favicons 7.3.1 itself moved to sharp ^0.35.3 with no API change on the calls favicons 7.2.0 makes. Drop once @mintlify/prebuild pins a favicons that depends on sharp >=0.35.5. nx/axios 1.20.0 -> the September-2026 axios advisory batch (twelve advisories, six HIGH, including GHSA-x97p-jq2g-jp4f, GHSA-m8m8-qj5v-23w3 and GHSA-3pq3-5fj3-cg6v), all fixed in 1.20.0; nx exact-pins axios 1.18.1, still in 23.2.1. Drop once nx pins axios >=1.20.0. @mintlify/models/axios 1.20.0 -> the axios advisories fixed in 1.20.0 (see nx/axios); @mintlify/models exact-pins axios 1.18.0 in its latest release. Drop once @mintlify/models pins axios >=1.20.0. nx/brace-expansion 5.0.12 -> GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr, GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p and GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7 (DoS), fixed in 5.0.12 on the 5.x line; nx exact-pins 5.0.8 (23.2.1 pins 5.0.9). Drop once nx pins brace-expansion >=5.0.12.

scripts.start: npx concurrently --kill-others 'npx nx run-many -t start -p twenty-server twenty-front' 'npx wait-on tcp:3000 && npx nx run twenty-server:worker'
